title: 7 · Misiurewicz-anchored
one_line: Nuclei found in the neighbourhood of preperiodic points.
blurb: Misiurewicz points stay on the boundary at every scale, so their neighbourhoods are dense in small components. The question is whether the nuclei living there differ in kind from what a plain scan finds.
